verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM can self-host via Docker as a server (docs-8, gh-1), and its documented API access and keys (docs-11) imply scripted, programmatic use without the desktop UI. That is a plausible path to headless automation, but the evidence is thin titles and taglines, and no published OpenAPI spec was found (probe-2). missing for 10: explicit headless/CI mode documentation, CLI or non-interactive invocation, CI pipeline examples, API endpoint detail or an OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of automated use.
